title: 人人都爱她

如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    阳光灿烂，笼罩在黑灰色的哥特式别墅上，夜晚显得格外阴森恐怖的房子，竟然也显得有些圣洁，门庭前枯黄的树叶落了一地，已经掉光了叶子的树下挂着一个秋千，前面是一个没有了水的小喷泉，上面同样有着不少枯叶，还有沉积了厚厚一层的干枯的污泥。
吱呀……
厚重的房门的卷曲着，面容是十分抢眼的精致，气质却十分的干净温暖。
一辆黑色的轿车停在了门口，穿着双排扣制服的司机走下车，微微弯腰，一向冷硬严肃的面容也稍微的温柔了一些，“小姐，昨夜过得开心吗？”
这屋子是沐如岚小时候过世的外婆送给她的礼物，沐如岚很喜欢这里，但是不愿意让别人进，连她最疼爱的二少爷和三少爷都不让进，而作为从小到大被捧住手心里宠着爱着的沐家公主，自然没人会去让她不开心，而且他们见沐如岚每次从这里回去之后心情都会很好，也就更加的由着她了。
毕竟这边这块，安全还是很有保障的。
沐如岚点点头，微笑着道：“嗯。”
司机为沐如岚拉开车门，闻言笑纹更深了一些，“您开心就好。”
司机叫陈海，是沐如岚的外公的亲信，懂武而且可靠，外公疼爱沐如岚，便差了陈海过来当沐如岚的私人司机兼保镖。
“先去楼兰阁吃早餐吗？”
“直接去学校吧，昨夜有点高兴过头了，都忘记今天学院很忙呢。”沐如岚道，嘴角带着浅浅的笑意，非常的温暖，只是这样看着你，便让人有种春日的阳光落在身上，温暖又干净。
陈海会意，眼睛扫过后视镜，看到沐如岚看向窗外，侧脸白皙干净，细细的绒毛显得十分的可爱，她嘴角带着温暖的淡笑，就像天使一样……
这是沐家和柯家的公主，更是许多人心中的天使，他们人人都爱她。
鎏斯兰学院。
这是一所国际闻名的贵族学院，中外合资，在各大院校中处于一线地位。
沐如岚今年十六岁，是鎏斯兰学院高中部的学生会会长，由鎏斯兰学院高中部全体学生选出，没错，是全体，没有一票反对票，即使在高中部，有许多人年纪比她大。
车子停在鎏斯兰学院金色的华丽大门前，沐如岚一下车，便叫人侧目，然后围上来跟她高兴问好，沐如岚在鎏斯兰学院，甚至在有名的三线贵族学院都名声很响，一是她的成绩，二是她的为人，三才是她的容貌家世，即使是最善妒的那个女孩在暗地里骂她，但是当有比不上沐如岚又不认识沐如岚的人在那里嚣张的说沐如岚怎么样的时候，她都会上去把她刻薄的说上一顿。
不认识沐如岚的人，没有资格说她的坏话。
下星期一是鎏斯兰学院的秋日校庆，三年一次，很盛大，而由于鎏斯兰的偏向国外的教育体系，学生们要亲自来布置校园和编排节目，这一切由学生会组织，然后各班分布任务去办，为的是培养学生们的实践能力。
沐如岚正在会长办公室处理公务，忽的有人急急忙忙闯了进来，“会长！”

沐如岚看向来人，她戴着一副小巧的椭圆形眼镜，嘴角勾着温暖的浅笑，显得斯文秀气，“怎么了？”
陈清这才觉得自己急躁了，抓了抓脑袋，有些脸红着急的道：“会长，有人在B座篮球场那边打架。是如森和如霖在和前两天新来的那个转校生，打得好凶，谁都拦不住，上去拦的都被打了！你快去看看！”
鎏斯兰谁都知道，沐如岚会长对两个双胞胎弟弟那是极好极好的，甚至可以说是极其的宠爱，这不，这人一说，沐如岚便变了脸色，连忙放下手中的活跑了出去。
B座篮球场，便是高中部B栋教学楼前面的篮球场，此时这里聚了不少围观的学生，有些学生手上还抱着箱子，里面是装饰班级要用的彩带等等东西。
而一圈人之中，三个少年扭打在了一起，或者说，是一对双胞胎在围殴一个少年，那拳头卯足了劲儿，一下下结结实实的，毫不留情，边上有几个脸上挂了彩的学生，都是想要阻止，结果被无辜殃及的。
沐家这两位少爷，任性起来的时候，他们真怀疑他们会把人给杀了。
“我操你妈！揍死你！看你敢不敢胡说！”沐如森眼里怒火几乎都具象化出来了，血红血红的，恨不得把人给杀了。

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to access the author's quick channel for copyright complaints. The sun is shining brightly, shrouding the black and gray Gothic villa. The house that looks particularly spooky at night actually looks a bit holy. The withered yellow leaves in front of the courtyard have fallen to the ground. A swing hangs under the tree that has lost all its leaves. In front of it is a small fountain without water. There are also many dead leaves on it, and a thick layer of dried sludge has accumulated.
Squeak...
The thick door is curled, the face is very eye-catching and delicate, but the temperament is very clean and warm.
A black car stopped at the door. The driver in a double-breasted uniform stepped out of the car, bent slightly, and his usually cold and serious face became slightly gentler. "Miss, did you have a good time last night?"
This house was a gift given to Mu Rulan by her grandmother who passed away when she was a child. Mu Rulan liked it very much, but she was unwilling to let others in, not even her favorite second and third young masters. As the princess of the Mu family who had been held in the palm of her hand and loved since she was a child, naturally no one would make her unhappy. Moreover, they saw that Mu Rulan was in a good mood every time she came back from here, so they let her go even more.
After all, safety here is still very guaranteed.
Mu Rulan nodded, smiled and said, "Yes."
The driver opened the door for Mu Rulan, and his smile lines deepened when he heard this, "As long as you are happy."
The driver's name was Chen Hai, who was a close confidant of Mu Rulan's grandfather. He knew martial arts and was reliable. Grandpa loved Mu Rulan so much that he sent Chen Hai to be Mu Rulan's personal driver and bodyguard.
"Would you like to go to Loulan Pavilion for breakfast first?"
"Go directly to school. I was a little too happy last night. I forgot that the college is very busy today." Mu Rulan said, with a slight smile on the corner of her mouth, very warm. Just looking at you like this makes people feel like the spring sunshine is falling on them, warm and clean.
Chen Hai understood, glanced at the rearview mirror, and saw Mu Rulan looking out the window. Her side face was fair and clean, and her thin down looked very cute. She had a warm smile on her lips, just like an angel...
This is the princess of the Mu family and the Ke family, and she is the angel in the hearts of many people. Everyone loves her.
Laoslan College.
This is an internationally renowned aristocratic college, a Sino-foreign joint venture, occupying a first-tier position among major institutions.
Mu Rulan is sixteen years old this year and is the student union president of the high school department of Luosilan College. She is elected by all the students of the high school department of Luosilan College. Yes, it is all students. There is not a single dissenting vote. Even in the high school department, there are many people older than her.
The car stopped in front of the golden and gorgeous gate of Luosilan College. When Mu Rulan got out of the car, she attracted people's attention, and then people gathered around her to say hello happily. Mu Rulan was very famous in Luosilan College, and even in the famous third-tier aristocratic colleges. Firstly, her grades, and secondly, her As a person, the third factor is her appearance and family background. Even if the most jealous girl scolds her secretly, when someone who is not as good as Mu Rulan and doesn't know Mu Rulan talks arrogantly about Mu Rulan, she will go up and say something mean to her.
People who don't know Mu Rulan are not qualified to speak ill of her.
Next Monday is the Autumn Anniversary of Luosilan College, which is held once every three years and is very grand. Due to Luosilan's foreign-oriented education system, students have to personally decorate the campus and arrange programs. All this is organized by the student union, and then each class is assigned tasks to do in order to cultivate students' practical abilities.
Mu Rulan was handling official business in the president's office when someone suddenly rushed in and said, "President!"
Mu Rulan looked at the person who came. She was wearing a pair of small oval glasses and had a warm smile on her lips. She looked elegant and elegant, "What's wrong?"
Only then did Chen Qing feel that he was impatient, scratched his head, blushed and said anxiously: "President, someone is playing basketball over there in Building B.shelf. It was Rusen and Rulin who were fighting the new transfer student who had arrived two days ago. They were fighting so fiercely that no one could stop him. Anyone who tried to stop him was beaten! Go and have a look! "
Everyone in Liu Silan knew that President Mu Rulan was extremely kind to her two twin brothers, and could even be said to be extremely doting. No, as soon as this person said this, Mu Rulan's expression changed, and she quickly put down her work and ran out.
The basketball court in Block B is the basketball court in front of the teaching building of Building B of the high school. At this time, there are many onlookers gathered here. Some students are holding boxes in their hands, which contain ribbons and other things used to decorate the class.
In a circle of people, three teenagers were fighting together, or in other words, a pair of twins were beating up a teenager. The fists were strong and strong, and they were merciless. There were a few students with disgraced faces beside them. They all wanted to stop them, but they were innocently affected.
When the two young masters of the Mu family became willful, they really suspected that they would kill people.
“I’ll fuck you! Beat you to death! See if you dare to talk nonsense! "The anger in Mu Rushen's eyes was almost tangible, and it was so red that he wanted to kill the person.
Little master, there will be more after this chapter ^.^, please click on the next page to continue. I like the rebirth of the master. It is too harsh, please.
